name: command-kernel
description: One headless command kernel as the single source of truth for every action and navigation in an app, rendered many ways (palette, agent, chords, deeplinks). A Bun-workspace monorepo: @command-kernel/core is the engine; the drivers are separate packages; the examples compose them.

scripts.build:packages: bun run --filter '@command-kernel/core' build && bun run --filter '@command-kernel/agent' build && bun run --filter '@command-kernel/ui' build
scripts.check:full: bun run check && bun run build:packages && bun run build && bun run lint:pkg
